subject: independence relations
statement: The paper conjectures that ↓^nm is the maximum well-behaved independence relation for Polish groups.

subject: Ramsey theorems
statement: The paper computes the ranks of discontinuity for the ordinal-indexed Ramsey problems RT^n_{α,β}.

subject: unary algebras
statement: The paper shows that locally finite unary algebras with finitely many 1-orbits are ω-categorical in tree-like cases.

subject: tolerant learning
statement: The paper introduces a new degree structure, the tolerant learning hierarchy, obtained by comparing tolerance relations according to the families they make learnable.

subject: structural completeness
statement: The paper proves that every quasivariety of finite type with CEP generated by finite algebras and containing an infinite irreducible algebra is not strongly structurally complete.

subject: Boolean hyperdoctrines
statement: The paper exhibits a non-full Boolean hyperdoctrine, showing that not all Boolean hyperdoctrines satisfy the generalized Beck-Chevalley condition.

subject: Schreier graphs of Z^n shifts
statement: The paper proves that the Borel and measurable oriented chromatic number of F(2^Z^n) is 5 for n>1.

subject: Ramsey degrees provability
statement: The paper establishes that 'Henson graphs have finite big Ramsey degrees' is provable in ACA_0'.

subject: model companions
statement: The paper shows that the model companion of an endomorphism has NATP whenever the base theory T does.

subject: many-one degrees and one-one degrees
statement: The paper generalizes Batyrshin's result to all nonrecursive and nonirreducible many-one degrees, showing that infinite antichains of one-one degrees can always be embedded.

subject: quantum logic
statement: The paper shows that orthocomplementation rearranges layers exactly as complementation rearranges elements, making layer duality rigid rather than accidental.

subject: formula decomposition
statement: The paper proves that every formula in every first-order theory is an existential composition of two stable NFCP formulas algebraic in the two outer variables.

subject: minimal well-determined logic
statement: The paper constructs a semantics for the minimal well-determined logic based on lower semilattices with a greatest element.

subject: modal logic completeness
statement: The paper proves that GL is the complete logic over infinite ω-scattered spaces.

subject: paraconsistent logic characterization
statement: The paper shows that paraconsistent logics in the Logics of Formal Inconsistency hierarchy can be characterized using hyper swap structures semantics generated by hyper Boolean algebras.

subject: splendid extensions
statement: The paper shows that if there is an ineffable cardinal then the non-existence of splendid extensions holds at some cardinal below it in ZFC.

subject: ergodic spaces homogeneity
statement: The paper proves that a nonsingular ergodic PSL_2(ℝ)-space with nonelementary finitely-generated stabilizers is homogeneous.

subject: nilpotent Lie groups
statement: The paper proves that the independence relation is unique for nilpotent Lie groups.

subject: Cantor-Bendixson and derivative ranks
statement: The paper proves the orthogonality of Cantor-Bendixson and derivative ranks.

subject: paraconsistent integration theory
statement: The paper embeds the integration theory of the Levi-Civita field into the paraconsistent Chunk and Permeate framework.

subject: modal-temporal language
statement: The paper analyzes the expressive power of the basic modal-temporal language across five order types and shows two distinct levels of definability.

subject: independence relations
statement: The paper provides an example showing ↓^Haar ≠ ↓^nm, distinguishing Haar null from non-meager independence.

subject: independence in expansions
statement: The paper provides a natural notion of independence in the expansion for H-structures and for beautiful pairs when the underlying structure is modular.

subject: tolerant learning
statement: The paper shows that the tolerant learning hierarchy is a bounded lower semilattice but not an upper semilattice, is atomless and coatomless, and contains chains and antichains of size continuum.

subject: semiproducts of modal logics
statement: The paper presents new examples of product and semiproduct logics of propositional modal logics with S5 that have the finite model property.

subject: Gödel completeness theorem
statement: The paper gives a self-contained proof of Gödel's completeness theorem entirely within the formalism of first-order Boolean doctrines.

subject: stable regularity lemmas
statement: The paper proves quantitative stable regularity lemmas for binary real-valued functions extending work of Malliaris and Shelah.

subject: Lebesgue measurable sets
statement: The paper proves stronger forms of theorems about the locatedness of Lebesgue measurable complemented sets in R^N.

subject: set theory fragments
statement: The paper concludes that ZFC^-+'every cardinal has a successor' is the only philosophically uncontroversial common fragment of any true set theory.

subject: modal logic formalization
statement: The paper develops substitution machinery including free/bound-variable predicates, capture-avoiding substitution, and induction principles for first-order quantifiers.

subject: relevant and modal logics
statement: The paper develops translations from relevant logics into normal modal logics to clarify structural connections.

subject: ray spaces
statement: The paper provides a combinatorial characterization for pairs of order-theoretic trees with homeomorphic ray spaces.

subject: Katetov reduction
statement: The paper proves that the inductive limit F_ω is not Katetov-reducible to the transfinite hierarchy H_ω.

subject: Post complete conditional logics
statement: The paper identifies all of the finitely many regular and normal Post complete conditional logics.

subject: Q-spaces and Δ-spaces
statement: The paper proves that the existence of a measurable cardinal, crowded Baire spaces of certain types, and measure-bearing topological spaces are equiconsistent.

subject: uniform bound extraction
statement: The paper extends uniform bound extraction theorems from normed structures to abstract metric structures.

subject: 2-stationarity of P_κλ
statement: The paper proves that strong compactness of κ does not imply the 2-stationarity of P_κλ for cardinals λ > κ.

subject: internal bialgebras
statement: The paper constructs for every bialgebraic theory T and Σ-model M within a 2-category the object M^T of internal T-bialgebras.

subject: conceptual completeness
statement: The paper characterizes conceptual completeness of a fragment in terms of a duality between theories and topoi.

subject: nonvanishing lim^k A
statement: The paper shows that it is relatively consistent with ZFC that b = d = ω_n and lim^k A ≠ 0 for 1 ≤ k ≤ n.

subject: geometric logic fragments
statement: The paper shows that conceptually complete fragments are conservatively embedded in full geometric logic.

subject: inference-behaviour semantics
statement: The paper finds semantic clauses for exactly 21 meaningful connectives among 10,816 possible connective rule pairs in two-dimensional sequent calculi.

subject: Fremlin tensor product
statement: The paper proves that the Fremlin projective tensor-product operation on ideal codes is Σ^0_2-measurable and has a G_δ graph.

subject: tame μ-AECs of modules
statement: The paper shows that under suitable syntactic assumptions, all tame μ-AECs of R-modules are almost stable.

subject: hereditary almost-linear profiles
statement: The paper proves a relative extension theorem for intersecting relations with hereditary almost-linear profiles.

subject: modal logics
statement: The paper proves modal completeness for several non-normal modal logics with respect to closure operator semantics.

subject: modal logic S4.1
statement: The paper proves the finite model property and decidability for the topological square of S4.1.

subject: Ramsey-theoretic finiteness
statement: The paper introduces finiteness classes RRT-Fin^m_n and CRT-Fin arising from Rainbow Ramsey and Canonical Ramsey theorems in choiceless set theory.

subject: modal logic semiproducts
statement: The paper presents new counterexamples of semiproducts not axiomatizable in the simplest way.

subject: tolerant learning
statement: The paper separates non-effective from computable tolerant learning by exhibiting a universal relation that is not computably universal.
